Quartic and quadratic factors were proved irreducible; all rational fibers and the four extra AEKS fibers were checked as quadratic squares with the requisite nonzero discriminants. Both primary papers prove their total K3 surfaces smooth. The packaged verifier itself executes successfully.

value.rationale: The two independent constructive proofs of the sharp characteristic-seven pointlessness threshold leave their geometric and arithmetic comparison unresolved. The result computes the entire natural fiber degeneration data (8I2+8I1 vs 12I2, with nontrivial Frobenius orbit and splitting patterns) and proves the explicit examples are not F7-isomorphic by different F49 counts. This is a meaningful comparative classification of two important extremal examples, not a routine restatement of their absence of rational points.
